docs.description: Engineering reports for nat-os. Read docs/README.md for index and reading order.

kernel.description: Kernel source — scheduler, heap, VM, drivers, display, touch, storage.

os-dev.description: Bare-metal ESP32 OS developer. Writes C and Xtensa assembly for the nat-os kernel.

os-debugger.description: Read-only embedded debugger. Investigates panics, crashes, and serial output without modifying code.

build.description: Build the nat-os image. Usage: /build [-WiFi] [-Board cyd|lora32]
build.template: Execute the workspace build script '.\build.ps1' with your optional flags: $ARGUMENTS. Review output console logs and fix compilation bugs if any fail.

flash.description: Build and flash to ESP32. Usage: /flash [-Port COM5] [-Board cyd]
flash.template: Compile and flash the firmware binary using your flags: $ARGUMENTS. Verify port connections and confirm when upload completes successfully.

panic.description: Investigate a kernel panic or crash. Usage: /panic <panic message or serial output>
panic.template: Analyze this specific kernel crash log or serial panic dump: $ARGUMENTS. Read relevant scheduler, heap, or driver source files via references to track down the root fault.
